output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 challenge fix scope depends on configuration
output.content: This bugfix addresses DNS01 challenges with Cloudflare after the Cloudflare API changed. The environment does not state whether Cloudflare DNS provider is configured for DNS01 challenges. If Cloudflare DNS01 is used, this fix is necessary. Check your ClusterIssuer or Issuer configurations for Cloudflare DNS01 provider usage.
